title: Payment creation becomes async while checkout adds retry messaging

agents.task: In src/lib/payments.ts, make createPayment asynchronous: declare it `async` and change its return type to `Promise<PaymentResult>`, simulating a gateway call with `await Promise.resolve()` before building the result. Keep the PaymentResult shape unchanged. Do not touch other files.

In src/app/checkout/page.tsx, extend CheckoutPage so that when the payment failed it returns `Payment failed, please retry (order <orderId>)` where orderId is the order id used for the payment ('ord_1'), and when it succeeds it keeps returning the redirect URL. Update src/tests/checkout.test.ts so it still passes and also covers the failed branch (you may add an optional amountCents parameter to CheckoutPage defaulting to 1299; createPayment fails when amountCents is 0). Do not touch src/lib/payments.ts.
